//: Post-office tunables, read via Get-SystemConfig. rotate_* / stream_retention_days: cleanup.ps1 log & mirror hygiene. sys_retention_days: age at which sys-* service mail (receipts, stall reports) is purged from inbox/processing, together with orphan .progress sidecars. dead_after_dispatches: wake attempts before route.ps1 returns a letter to its sender (0 = never return). poll_hooks: agents rung by the watch loop on inbox arrival (2s debounce, {count}/{agent}/{root} placeholders) - replaces per-minute poll.py scheduled tasks on this host; poll.py itself stays for agent-hosted scheduling. audit_notify_minutes: watch-loop cadence for registry-audit findings -> one AUDIT sys mail per agent per finding, strictly once (ledger post/audit-notify.json; 0 = off). Delete keys to fall back to defaults.
